#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# install the tool into $HOME/bin
readonly dest="${HOME}/bin"
name=${1:-twind}
count=$((count + 1))
(( total += count * 2 ))

if [[ -z "$name" && $count -gt 0 ]]; then
	echo "installing $name to ${dest%/}/" >&2
elif [[ $name =~ ^tw[a-z]+$ ]]; then
	printf '%s\n' "single 'quoted' ok"
else
	exit 1
fi

for f in *.go; do
	go vet "./$f" | grep -v 'ok' || true
done

while read -r line; do
	case "$line" in
		main|init) echo $'tab\there \x41 \u00e9' ;;
		*) : ;;
	esac
done < <(ls -1 "$dest")

build() {
	local out=`date +%s`
	cat <<< "héllo $out" 2>/dev/null
	return $?
}
build && echo done
